info.title: Migration Service API
info.description: Informatica IDMC to Spring Batch migration service

post.description: Generate a Business Requirements Document (BRS) from an Informatica IDMC export file (ZIP or XML) stored in S3. Call this when the user wants to analyze an Informatica export or generate a BRS.

s3_bucket.description: The S3 bucket containing the Informatica export file

s3_key.description: The S3 key (path) of the export file. Must be a ZIP or XML file.

brs_file_path.description: S3 path of the generated BRS document

post.description: Generate Spring Batch Java code from a BRS document and push it to a new GitHub repository. Call this after a BRS has been generated.

brs_s3_path.description: The full S3 path of the BRS document returned from generateBrs (e.g. s3://bucket/brs/brs-xxx.md)

repo_name.description: Name for the GitHub repository where the generated Spring Batch code will be pushed

200.description: Spring Batch code generated and pushed to GitHub

spring_batch_repo_url.description: GitHub URL of the generated Spring Batch project
